entity_reviews.llm_reasoning: The formula LiNi0.94Co0.04Zn0.02O1.99 is explicitly stated in the paper multiple times, including in the Abstract (Page 15324) and again in the Introduction (Page 15325) and Conclusions (Page 15330). The alleged provenance (Page 15325, Experimental Section 2.1) is slightly off in placement: Section 2.1 on page 15325 does include “LiNi0.94Co0.04Zn0.02O1.99 cathode materials were then prepared…”, which directly supports the extracted target formula.

The paper explicitly identifies the baseline cathode material as LiNi0.94Co0.06O2 (NC). This appears in the Abstract (Page 15324) and again in the Experimental Section 2.1 (Page 15325): “LiNi0.94Co0.06O2 and LiNi0.94Co0.04Zn0.02O1.99 cathode materials were then prepared…”. Therefore the extracted Target Formula LiNi0.94Co0.06O2 is supported (even though the alleged provenance points to Page 15325, it is also stated elsewhere).

In Experimental Section 2.1 (page 15325), the paper explicitly lists NiSO4·6H2O as part of a 2.0 M aqueous solution prepared with CoSO4·7H2O and ZnSO4·7H2O. However, it does not provide a specific mass, volume, or molar amount of NiSO4·6H2O itself—only the overall solution concentration (2.0 M) and the Ni/Co/Zn molar ratio (94:4:2). Therefore, the extractor’s statement that the amount of NiSO4·6H2O is not specified is supported.

The paper explicitly lists CoSO4·7H2O as a reagent in Experimental Section 2.1 (materials preparation): “a 2.0 M aqueous solution of NiSO4·6H2O, CoSO4·7H2O, and ZnSO4·7H2O … was first prepared.” However, the extracted statement says the amount is “Not specified in text.” While no mass or volume is given for CoSO4·7H2O, an amount/concentration is specified for the prepared mixed solution (2.0 M total transition-metal sulfate solution). Therefore, stating “amount not specified” is not accurate as at least the solution molarity is provided.
entity_reviews.llm_suggested_fix: CoSO4·7H2O | Amount: part of a 2.0 M aqueous solution of NiSO4·6H2O, CoSO4·7H2O, and ZnSO4·7H2O (Ni/Co/Zn = 94:4:2); no individual mass/volume for CoSO4·7H2O specified.
